subject.title: ci: stress race detection with a GOMAXPROCS sweep and repeat count

question: Should this repository accept the proposed recurring race-test cadence of GOMAXPROCS 2 and 8 with five executions each on both Ubuntu and macOS?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent and has real workflow proof, but the acceptable ongoing CI time and runner-cost tradeoff is a repository policy choice rather than a defect that review automation can resolve.

options.title: Accept the full stress sweep
options.body: Merge the current two-value, five-repeat race matrix and explicitly own the resulting recurring CI runtime.

options.title: Reduce the cadence
options.body: Ask for a smaller repeat count, fewer GOMAXPROCS values, or one platform if current CI capacity cannot absorb the full sweep.

recommendation.title: Accept the full stress sweep
recommendation.body: Merge the current two-value, five-repeat race matrix and explicitly own the resulting recurring CI runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only person tied to the exact workflow proposal and its runtime proof in the available evidence; a repository CI owner should make the final policy decision.
